involved.title: There’s more than one way to help.
involved.adoptDescription: Give a rescue dog the forever home they’ve been waiting for.
involved.donateDescription: Help cover food, veterinary care, supplies, transportation, and daily needs.
involved.volunteerDescription: Give your time and skills to help support the sanctuary and the dogs.

mission.title: A life-saving dream made real.
mission.paragraph1: Founded by Jessica Lopez, a wife and mother of three, J-Lo Animal Rescue is a heartfelt life-long dream of Jessica’s that has blossomed into a life-saving reality in Albany, Ga.
mission.paragraph2: What started as a mission to save several emaciated dogs discovered in a local backyard has grown into a thriving non-profit sanctuary that now provides a safe haven for over 60 dogs at a time.
mission.paragraph3: We are dedicated to transforming lives through compassion and faith, ensuring that every animal in our care finds the love and dignity they deserve.

donation.title: Help us save the next one.
donation.description: Your support gives rescued dogs food, medical care, shelter, transportation, and the chance to heal.

hero.subheadlineLine1: A safe haven. A second chance.

faqs.title: Before You Adopt
faqs.question1: How do I adopt a dog?
faqs.answer1: Browse available dogs, send an inquiry, complete the application, and work with us through the matchmaking process.
faqs.question2: Can I meet a dog first?
faqs.answer2: Yes. Meetings are coordinated directly with the rescue as part of the adoption process.
faqs.question3: Why is a home walkthrough required?
faqs.answer3: It helps us make sure the environment is appropriate and safe for the dog.
